authority: Direct source review of inbox convergence and comment capsule selection; no monitor or hosted operations executed
semanticInputs: Observed PR number, head, check outcomes, review-thread state and merge status
Existing thread inbox row IDs and acknowledgement state
Comment kind, identity, author, bot classification, body, URL and creation/submission timestamp
Comment window start and acting login
Consumer-specific persisted comment cursors and in-memory watermark
Current clock when opening a comment stream
Three paginated GitHub comment/review API responses and gh exit status
effects: Dispatches each failing check to the existing remediation writer
Reads persisted thread acknowledgements and appends outstanding-thread rows
Appends base-drift rows when the observed merge status is BEHIND
Writes error messages for caught thread/base row append failures
Capsule selection itself transforms supplied data without executing a child process
Appends qualifying comment rows before acknowledging the collected batch
Advances the in-memory cursor, then attempts best-effort persistence
Logs a warning when cursor persistence fails; persistence failure is not a successful durable acknowledgement
cacheDisposition: Fresh external observation and mutable inbox operations cannot be replaced by task-result replay. Any separately qualified pure capsule transformation must include the complete comment and window values.
limits: Remediation, Inbox, Ack, WatchStream, comment normalization, clipped-response salvage and state-write atomicity remain outside this bounded review.
Source review does not prove runtime capture safety, caller head pinning, signed transport or complete comment delivery.

observations: Collects issue comments, inline review comments and review bodies concurrently with concurrency 3; review bodies are filtered locally because the endpoint receives no since parameter.
Unreadable, invalid or wrong-PR persisted state produces no usable watermark.
Ref.set precedes best-effort state persistence; warn-only failure can leave memory ahead of durable state.
Transport output truncation has its own handling outside the reviewed fetch span.
